infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the Saferoom Exfil extraction on Interchange.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Object #11SR keycard (#11SR) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: An electronic limited-use access keycard that, according to the logo on the front, belongs to TerraGroup.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Requires the Interchange power station switch to be on in order to be used

- The door will lock itself after closing, and extract any PMC inside, while Scavs inside will be trapped.
- Other PMCs can steal the loot inside and use the extraction
- Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the quest Provocation

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- Pockets and bags of Scavs
- On Cultists
- On The Goons
- In Rare valuables crates

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text:
- On Partisan
- At the three-story dorms in the "marked room"
- At the "giving tree" behind the "Old Gas Station"

sections.heading: Reserve
sections.text:
- On Glukhar
- In the "marked rooms" RB-BK, RB-PKPM and RB-VO

sections.heading: Streets of Tarkov
sections.text:
- On Kaban
- In the "marked room" at the abandoned factory
- In the "marked room" at Chekannaya 13

sections.heading: The Lab
sections.text: - In Kruglov's office (R22) and the safe inside of it

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Behind a urinal that is located in the men's toilet at the "Burger spot" restaurant on the second floor of the mall on Interchange. The keypad is revealed upon flushing the urinal.

sections.heading: Behind The Lock
sections.text:
Unlocks the door to the Saferoom Exfil extraction on Interchange that is located in the parking lot section C.

On the inside can be found:
- Multiple weapon mod spawns
- Modded M4A1's
- 1x Weapon box (4x4)
- 1x Weapon box (6x4)
- 1x Weapon box (6x6)

- Rare item spawns
- A lever to open the green TerraGroup Object-14 container that can also contain weapons and weapon mods

sections.heading: Crafting
sections.text: | VPX Flash Storage Module x1; VPX Flash Storage Module; +; UHF RFID Reader x1; UHF RFID Reader; +; Secure Flash drive x5; Secure Flash drive; +; Object 21WS keycard x1; Object 21WS keycard; +; Secure magnetic tape cassette x1; Secure magnetic tape cassette | → | Intelligence Center level 2; 65 h 33 min 20 sec | → | Object 11SR keycard x1; Object 11SR keycard |

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- The serial code on the front side of the keycard is "000496855 076 5346" and the inscription at the back side is "Area code 14-4-KORD TGSWCAT-3".
- The "SR" in 11SR stands for Safe Room.
